subject.title: fix: A2A handoffs can duplicate message-tool replies

question: Should maintainers resolve the current-main conflict and accept this waited A2A artifact-suppression boundary for message-tool mirror and inter-session transcript rows before merge?
rationale: The patch appears correct and well-proven, but it intentionally changes message-delivery eligibility and now overlaps a newer merged A2A delivery-failure change, which CI alone cannot choose for maintainers.

options.title: Resolve Conflict And Accept Boundary
options.body: Rebase or merge current main into the branch, preserve the delayed-failure notification path from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99907, and land after exact-head checks if the boundary is accepted.

options.title: Request Live Channel Proof
options.body: Keep the branch open and ask for a redacted live WhatsApp or equivalent channel transcript if deterministic Gateway/qa-channel proof is not enough for this delivery path.

options.title: Defer To Broader A2A Coordination
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want the reverse-send, compaction, delayed-failure, and mirror-dedupe work resolved under one coordinated A2A delivery plan.

recommendation.title: Resolve Conflict And Accept Boundary
recommendation.body: Rebase or merge current main into the branch, preserve the delayed-failure notification path from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99907, and land after exact-head checks if the boundary is accepted.
